To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
microencapsulation of omega 3 in fish oil microcapsule (Mo) and microcapsules (Mu) can be used as a tool for increasing the EPA and DHA content in cooked and dry-cured meat products.

the fish oil microcapsule could be indicated as a vehicle for the enrichment of the cooked and dry cured pork meat products without influencing physicochemical characteristics, oxidative stability and acceptability of the final products.

the use of Mo and Mu microencapsulation as vehicles of EPA and DPA in cooked and dry meat products, subjected to culinary heating and dry cured manufacturing, storage at 4 °C and cooking, is a feasible alternative to increase their content of omega 3 without affecting physico chemical characteristics and quality.

the evaluation of the use of Mo and Mu microencapsulation as vehicles to enrich the meat products with omega 3 fatty acid.
the use of Mo and Mu microencapsulated fish oil as vehicles for the incorporation of EPA and DPA in meat products subjected to different manufacturing, storage and culinary treatments.
the development of new meat products with high content of EPA and DPA, which can be used as source of omega 3 for human consumption.

the use of Mo and Mu microencapsulated EPA and DHA could be considered as viable strategy to enrich meat products, leading to meat products with higher nutritional value, and with no impairment on their overall quality, and that the storage at refrigeration did not impair their quality.

the use of Mo and Mu microencapsulated fish oil as vehicles to enrich cooked and dry cured meats is a feasible strategy for increasing the omega 3 content without influencing the quality of the final product.
the use of Mo and Mu fish oil microcapsule in cooked and dry-cured meat products could be a good alternative to increase the quantity of EPA+DHA without affecting the quality of the final product.

the microencapsulation of EPA and DPA in fish oil microcapsule could be a viable strategy for the enrichment of meat products subjected to cooking and dry cured processing.
